name: Bikeable
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (cd backend && uv sync) && (cd frontend && npm ci)

terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: FastAPI backend served by uvicorn on port 8000 (fixture city works with no prebuilt data).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server on port 5173; proxies /api to the backend.
terminals.command: cd frontend && API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8000 VITE_API_MODE=live VITE_DEFAULT_CITY_ID=fixture npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
